text:
Maya: quick sync — need to lock down the compact preview for eval runs before next release. main asks: how dense can the score summary be, where to put bulk CTAs, and how keyboard / screenreader flows should behave. uploading frames now.
Jon: skimmed the frames in Figma. a couple quick notes: compact rows look good but the score chip wraps awkwardly under ~340px; the export control sits visually next to the primary bulk CTA which makes the affordance noisy.
Priya: from usability sessions, people expect an obvious primary action per row (approve/reject) and a clear global bulk control. when the global control is visually subtle they keep using row actions.
Alex: dev note: current approach hides columns on mobile with `display: none` which removes them from assistive tech. better to keep them in DOM and use `aria-hidden` + visually-hidden styles. will add tabbable focus tests.
Sam: accessibility nits: score chip color (green on white) fails AA at small sizes. bulk banner should be `role="region"` with an `aria-label` and status updates should use `aria-live="polite"`.
Maya: proposed banner + CTAs — please comment: banner: "Confirm approvals for selected tests" primary CTA: "Approve selected" secondary: "More actions" helper text: "Undo available for 48 hours in Activity"
Jon: copy tweak: remove counts from the CTA itself, keep counts in helper text only. :+1: on moving export into the kebab menu.
Priya: agree. also add a tooltip on hover: "Marking as approved records a pass for this eval run" 12 users asked for explicit effect text.
Alex: layout idea: on very small widths show condensed ratio `45/60` (passes/total) instead of percentage, easier to size and still informative.
Sam: keyboard flow: toggling select-all should not move focus away. propose `cta.focus({preventScroll: true})` and ensure the bulk toggle has `aria-pressed` semantics. will test with NVDA/VoiceOver.
Maya: design ask for Jon: produce stacked banner variant (count above, CTAs below) and inline variant (count left, CTAs right). which scales better across breakpoints?
Jon: stacked looks cleaner for narrow widths, inline is denser for >=880px. I'll upload both variants with annotated breakpoints in ~20m.
Alex: implementation plan: branch `feat/compact-preview-a11y` and add a small E2E that asserts `aria-live` announcements and focus retention. will open PR once CI passes.
CI-bot: queued job: `a11y-smoke/compact-preview` (reacts :white_check_mark:)
Priya: one more microcopy nit 12 helper text should explicitly include undo window: "You can undo bulk approvals for 48 hours" — that reduced anxiety in tests.
Maya: perfect. final checklist: - Jon: upload stacked + inline frames - Alex: implement aria-live + focus handling + E2E - Sam: verify contrast ratios and `aria-*` attributes - Priya: finalize tooltip + undo copy - I'll schedule a quick sign-off slot in Tue design review.
Jon: got it. posting frames shortly. :eyes:
Alex: branch created, starting work.
Sam: will run quick VO pass when frames are posted.
Maya: thanks all 12 please keep follow-ups here so sign-off is quick.
